title: DC-area forecast: Humid tomorrow with showers and storms likely
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Moderately muggy 70s this evening. Shower chances increase toward dawn.

What’s next? More humid Tuesday with showers and storms likely, especially during the afternoon and evening. Not quite as humid Wednesday through Friday, with decreasing chances for showers and storms.

Forecast in detail

Tonight: Partly cloudy and muggy overnight with a light breeze and lows near 70. Toward morning, scattered showers or thunderstorms can't be ruled out. Confidence: Medium-High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Tuesday): It could be an active day with a chance of showers and a thunderstorm in the morning, then scattered showers and storms are likely during the afternoon and evening. Some storms could be severe. It's not a washout, and the sun may break out for a time midday, helping push highs into the low to mid-80s. Humidity is rather high, with dew points in the low 70s. Winds are from the southwest at 10 to 15 mph with higher gusts. Confidence: Medium

Tomorrow night: Scattered showers and storms could continue into the evening until about 10 p.m. Partly cloudy skies overnight as lows settle near 70. Confidence: Medium

📬 Get our forecast in your inbox

Our morning forecast email is back! It's included with every level of support — from Free to Sustainer — delivered 7 days a week. Sign up at: capitalweather.com/support-us

A look ahead

Wednesday is partly sunny and a little less humid, but scattered afternoon showers and storms could still pop up, especially east and northeast of DC. Highs reach the mid-80s. Skies gradually clear Wednesday night, with lows in the 60s. Confidence: Medium

Thursday and Friday may be the nicest days of the week, featuring partly to mostly sunny skies, moderate humidity (dew points from 60 to 65), and highs in the mid-80s. Rain chances are low, but there's a very small chance of a brief afternoon shower either day. Overnight lows settle in the 60s Confidence: Medium

Humidity gradually increases over the weekend, along with the chance for showers and storms. Highs range from the mid-80s to around 90, with lows near 70. Sunday looks a bit more humid than Saturday and has the better chance for showers and storms. Confidence: Medium

DC weather history for July 27

A day of sharp contrasts, featuring record chill in 1920 and deadly, triple-digit heat in 1940.

Today’s daily digit — 5/10: We've seen hotter and muggier days, but the digit is trending downward as humidity and storm chances increase a bit. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.
